title: GTA 6 Cops Remember Your Outfit: How to Lose Them
short_title: GTA 6 cops remember your outfit (GTA 5's didn't) #GTA6 #Shorts

short_description:
In GTA 5 the wanted level faded once the cops lost sight of you. GTA 6's doesn't just run out: police track your face, your clothes and your car (icons under the wanted stars show what they know), and the area of the crime stays hot after you escape. To lose them: change clothes, switch cars and get out of the area. No story spoilers.

Sources: GamesRadar, Engadget, VICE, games.gg, GTABase.

short_es.title: La POLICÍA de GTA 6 recuerda tu ropa (la de GTA 5 no) 🚨 #GTA6 #Shorts
short_es.description: En GTA 6 la búsqueda no se acaba con un temporizador. La policía rastrea tu cara, tu ropa y tu coche (los iconos bajo las estrellas muestran lo que saben), y la zona del crimen sigue caliente. Para perderlos: cambia de ropa, de coche y sal de la zona. Sin spoilers. Fuentes: GamesRadar, Engadget, VICE, games.gg, GTABase.

sources: GamesRadar - GTA 6 wanted system goes up to 6 stars and lets police track your face, your clothes and your car: https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-wanted-system-goes-up-to-6-stars-and-lets-police-track-your-face-your-clothes-and-your-car/
Engadget - GTA 6's cops will remember you thanks to the 'Heat' system: https://engadget.com/2320983/gta-6s-cops-will-remember-you-thanks-to-the-heat-system/
games.gg - GTA 6 police are harder to shake off: https://games.gg/news/gta-6-police-smarter-memory-radar/
facts_note: Nov 24: police track face, clothes and vehicle, shown as icons under the stars (GamesRadar, Engadget, VICE, games.gg); 6 stars; no simple timer reset; crime areas stay flagged/hot (GamesRadar, games.gg); lose them by changing clothes, switching vehicles, leaving the search area (VICE, GTABase, games.gg). Left out (one source only): splitting Jason and Lucia drops a star. Re-check right before posting. GTA 5 comparison: earlier GTAs treated the wanted level as a timer that reset once you were out of view (GamesRadar, games.gg). Nov 24 market: 'GTA 5 vs GTA 6 Cops' was the hottest GTA 6 Short (~268K views/h), so this one is framed as a comparison.
